result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per rolling 12 months, 30 days’ written notice, during business hours, by an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, with no direct or remote systems access. Section 22.2 retains the required cost allocation and 5% underpayment threshold. The added off-site records-production mechanism and minimal-disruption standard are narrowly tailored, preserve a workable usage-verification right, and do not alter unrelated commercial terms.
